CSE 1071-B                                                                                                              about:srcdoc  
  
  
  Exam Date & Time: 27-May-2023 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  SECOND SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - MAY/JUNE 2023  
  SUBJECT: CSE 1071-CHM/ CSE 1071-B/ CSE 1051-B - PROBLEM SOLVING USING  
  COMPUTERS  
  PROBLEM SOLVING USING COMPUTERS [CSE 1071-CHM]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1A)          Describe briefly the following components of a computer:  
  i) Control unit  
  ii) Memory Unit                                                                             (3)  
  iii) Operating System  
  
  1B)          List the rules for Valid variable name in C. State whether the following variable names  
  are valid or invalid.  
  i) _age  
  ii) 1st_variable                                                                            (3)  
  iii) Int_name  
  iv) First&second  
  
  1C)          Write an algorithm and draw a flowchart to find the smallest triangular number which is  
  greater than the given input number. [Triangular numbers are 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 21, .. and so (4)  
  on. nth triangular number is sum of integers from 1 through n.]  
  
  2A)          Write a C program to calculate largest of three numbers and then find whether the largest  
  number is an even number or odd number using conditional operators. If it is an even      (3)  
  number, then add 10 to it otherwise subtract 10 from it using conditional operator.  
  
  2B)          i) Write a program using do-while loop to read the numbers until -1 is entered. From the  
  numbers read, count the number of perfect numbers using for loop.  
  ii) Compare and contrast break and continue statement with relevant programs.            (5)  
  (3+2 = 5 marks)  
  
  2C)          Evaluate the following expressions by showing all the intermediate steps in the order of  
  evaluation. Assume a=10, b=5, c=30.  
  (2)  
  
  
  3A)          Write a C program to read 1D array of size n and remove all the prime numbers from the  
  array and display the modified array.                                                  (3)  
  
  3B)          Write a C program to read a 2D matrix of size MxM and for each row, replace the largest (3)

  element by the sum of row elements and display the final resultant matrix.  
  
  3C)             Explain the functions strcpy() and strcmp() with proper syntax. Write a C program to  
  remove all characters in string except alphabets.                                          (4)  
  (2+2 = 4 marks)  
  
  4A)             Write a function namely myFact in C to find the factorial of a given number. Also write  
  another function namely, nCr which accepts two positive integer parameters n and r and  
  returns the value of the mathematical function:  
  (3)  
  
  
  The function nCr is expected to make use of the factorial function myFact.  
  
  4B)             Distinguish between Call by Value and Call by Reference in C. Design two unique C  
  functions to justify the concept of Call by Value and Call by Reference and also depict    (5)  
  their respective function calls and function prototype declarations.  
  
  4C)             Write a program in C to print even or odd numbers in a given range using recursion.  
  Input the range to print starting from 1-10  
  Expected Output:                                                                           (2)  
  All even numbers from 1 to 10 are : 2 4 6 8 10  
  All odd numbers from 1 to 10 are : 1 3 5 7 9  
  
  5A)             Write a C program using pointers to reverse a given string prompted at run time.  
  (3)  
  
  5B)             Implement a C program to read records of n different employee in structure having  
  members name, empid, salary. Display the complete employee details sorted by salary        (3)  
  from highest to lowest.  
  
  5C)             List out the types of Cyberattacks where computers become target of crime in case of  
  businesses and individuals. Also explain importance of having strong cybersecurity         (4)  
  measures.  
  
  
  -----End-----
